scope: Marine quartet technical publication evidence; no formal candidate or hardware acceptance

archive_policy.raw_reports: Copied byte-for-byte from CI artifacts. Paths and localhost URLs inside reports identify original CI runtime locations; they are not archive download links.
archive_policy.screenshots: All 16 new-model bilingual browser captures plus 4 corresponding all-model detail captures retained. Older screenshots mentioned by raw reports are intentionally not duplicated.
archive_policy.source_images: 384 gallery files and 8 card image files already exist in the release merge. SHA-256 and byte-comparison evidence is retained instead of duplicates.
archive_policy.index: file-hashes.json lists every archived file except itself; integrity of the index is provided by the archive Git commit.

limitations: Browser QA used Chromium 141.0.7390.37 with software rendering and emulated mobile viewports.
The strict-gpu CI profile name denotes real WebGL/GLTFLoader execution; it is not physical GPU acceptance.
Physical device and target-scene acceptance are unverified.
The parser report is geometry and embedded-image decoding evidence only; it explicitly does not establish rendering or visual review.
Build and static checks are not substituted for browser or deployment verification.
